items.title: DGFT to Organise State-Level Workshop on Effective Utilisation of Free Trade Agreements in Hyderabad
items.summary: 31 OCT 2026 1:15PM by PIB Hyderabad The Office of the Additional Director General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), Hyderabad, in collaboration with the Government of Telangana, is organising a state-level workshop on leveraging Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) on November 2, 2026, at T-Hub Knowledge City, Madhapur, Hyderabad.

facts.text: The programme will feature dedicated sectoral breakout sessions focusing on key export-oriented sectors, including pharmaceuticals, engineering, textiles, and gems and jewellery.

The sessions are expected to facilitate interaction between policymakers, industry representatives and exporters, enabling the identification of sector-specific opportunities, addressing challenges in FTA utilisation and recommending practical measures to improve export performance.

The programme is expected to support the state’s export growth by enabling businesses to leverage preferential market access and emerging opportunities under India’s recently signed Free Trade Agreements.

items.title: INAUGURAL BIMSTEC MARITIME SECURITY EXERCISE
items.summary: 31 OCT 2026 3:38PM by PIB Delhi Shared Seas, Shared Security and Shared Prosperity The inaugural BIMSTEC Maritime Security Exercise, being conducted from 30 Oct to 03 Nov 2026, marks a significant milestone in advancing maritime cooperation among the member states of BIMSTEC.

facts.text: Bringing together Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Thailand, the exercise reinforces the shared commitment of member states towards regional security, stability and prosperity in the Bay of Bengal.

Building upon the outcomes of the 6th BIMSTEC Summit under the theme “BIMSTEC: Prosperous, Resilient and Open”, the exercise provides a practical framework for enhancing maritime cooperation and operational linkages among participating nations.
The exercise aims to enhance interoperability, strengthen maritime domain awareness, improve coordination mechanisms and promote the exchange of Best Practices among BIMSTEC member states.
The exercise also highlights the strategic importance of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and the role of the Andaman and Nicobar Command (ANC), India’s first integrated tri-service command.

EPFO provides provident fund savings, pension and insurance benefits to eligible members. The increase in the mandatory coverage wage ceiling from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 is expected to bring over 51 lakh additional employees within its ambit.

facts.text: The increase in the mandatory coverage wage ceiling from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 is expected to bring over 51 lakh additional employees within its ambit.
The scheme offers insurance benefits of up to ₹7 lakh, without requiring members to pay a separate insurance premium.
Contributing members rose from 3.49 crore in 2014-15 to approximately 7.98 crore (as on 16 September, 2026).
This represents an increase of approximately 4.49 crore contributing members over the period.

facts.text: Every drop of rain must be conserved to make villages water-secure and self-reliant. ” He urged villagers to take collective responsibility for regular maintenance and repair of the water harvesting structures created under Watershed Development Scheme, so that these assets remain functional for …
The Secretary also reviewed farm ponds, horticulture plantations and agricultural equipment provided to beneficiaries under the scheme, along with benefits extended to women’s self-help groups.

Priority works include percolation tanks, storage ponds, storage bunds and Kolhapuri-type weirs, which are expected to improve rainwater storage, strengthen village water availability, provide protective irrigation to crops and reduce the vulnerability of agriculture to drought-like conditions.
